units.text: Fund F01 Decision-Support Summary
Largest One-Year Drawdown (Last Decade): 18.0% – Indicates moderate volatility.
Consistency of Distributions: Paid a quarterly distribution in 11 of the last 12 quarters – Suggests reliable income potential.
Holding Requirement: Two-year holding period for the reduced-fee share class – May limit short-term flexibility.
Three-Year Annualized Return: 8.2% – Reflects above-average growth over the past three years.
Expense Ratio: 1.45% – Considered moderate, though investors should assess value for cost.
Diversification: Holds 140 securities across 9 sectors – Provides broad diversification.
This summary is intended to support your evaluation of Fund F01 as part of your retirement investment strategy.
Decision-Support Summary for Fund F01
Fund F01 offers a balanced opportunity for retirement investors seeking consistent income and long-term growth.
Over the past three years, it has delivered an annualized return of 8.2%, reflecting solid performance.
The fund has also provided quarterly distributions in 11 of the past 12 quarters, making it a reliable income source.
While the fund experienced a maximum one-year drawdown of 18.0% in the last decade, it has demonstrated resilience and recovery, aligning with a moderate risk profile.
It holds 140 securities across 9 sectors, offering broad diversification to help manage risk.

With an expense ratio of 1.45%, Fund F01 is competitively priced for its class, and the reduced-fee share class is available with a two-year holding requirement, which may be suitable for investors planning a longer-term commitment.
Fund F01 can be a strategic component of a diversified retirement portfolio, particularly for those seeking steady income and growth potential with moderate risk.
Decision-Support Summary: Account F02
No monthly fee if balance remains above $500; $12 monthly fee if below $500.
High introductory APY of 4.10% for the first six months, then reduces to 1.25%.
Cash deposits must be made at partner branches only.
Transfers between linked accounts post on the same business day.
Consider maintaining a balance above $500 to avoid fees and maximize interest during the introductory period.
Account F02 Decision-Support Summary for New Customers
Overview:
Account F02 is a savings account offering a high initial return for the first six months, making it ideal for new savers looking to grow their initial deposit quickly.
Key Features:
High Initial APY: Earn 4.10% Annual Percentage Yield (APY) for the first six months — significantly higher than most standard savings accounts.
Lower APY After 6 Months: After the introductory period, the APY drops to 1.25%.
No Monthly Fee with Minimum Balance: Avoid fees by maintaining a balance of $500 or more.
Fee for Low Balance: A $12 monthly fee applies if the balance falls below $500.
Convenient Transfers: Transfers between linked accounts post on the same business day.
Deposit Access: Cash deposits are accepted only at partner branches.
Considerations for New Customers:
Ideal for Short-Term Savings Goals: The high initial APY makes Account F02 a strong choice if you plan to save for a specific goal within six months.
Balance Management Important: To avoid monthly fees, ensure your balance stays above $500.
Deposit Limitations: If cash deposits are important, confirm the location of partner branches for convenience.
Conclusion:
Account F02 is well-suited for first-time savers with a short-term savings objective and the ability to maintain a minimum balance.
The high introductory APY offers a strong start, but balance management is key to avoiding fees and maximizing returns.
Mortgage F03 Decision-Support Summary
Fixed Rate Period: 5.2% for the first 5 years.
Rate Adjustment: After year five, the rate adjusts annually.
Prepayment Flexibility: Up to 15% of the principal can be prepaid each year without penalty.
Prepayment Charge: A 0.5% fee applies for prepayments exceeding the annual cap.
Closing Time: As few as 21 days from application.
Origination Fee: 1.8% of the loan amount.
This mortgage offers a stable start with a fixed rate but requires consideration of future rate adjustments.
Prepayment is allowed but limited, with a penalty for exceeding the cap.
The quick closing time is a benefit, though the origination fee adds to upfront costs.
Mortgage F03 Decision-Support Summary
Mortgage F03 offers a fixed interest rate of 5.2% for the first five years, providing stability in your monthly payments during that period.
After year five, the rate adjusts annually based on market conditions.
You may make principal prepayments of up to 15% of the loan balance per year without penalty, offering flexibility to pay down the loan faster if desired.
Any prepayments exceeding this annual cap will incur a 0.5% prepayment charge.
The mortgage can be closed in as few as 21 days, supporting a timely home purchase.
A 1.8% origination fee applies to the loan amount at closing.
Mortgage F03 is well-suited for households with a fixed income who value initial rate stability and the option to prepay within set limits.
Consider your long-term financial goals and potential interest rate trends beyond year five when deciding on the loan amount and commitment.

Decision-Support Summary: Plan F04
Plan F04 offers comprehensive coverage designed to support individuals requiring frequent care.
With a monthly premium of $540, the plan includes dental and vision benefits, making it a convenient all-in-one option for essential health needs.
Prescription coverage includes a fixed copay for generics, providing predictable costs for medication.
For out-of-network care, the plan offers 50% reimbursement after a $3,200 annual deductible.
While this deductible is higher than some plans, the flexibility to access care beyond the network may be valuable for those with complex or ongoing health needs.

Decision-Support Summary: Portfolio F05
Portfolio F05 is a balanced investment option designed for retirement savers seeking a mix of stability and growth. Here’s a concise overview to help you decide:
Stable Performance: Over ten years, the portfolio demonstrated lower volatility (3.3% less than the peer average), which may appeal to those prioritizing capital preservation.
Conservative Allocation: Combines investment-grade bonds and global equities for a diversified approach.

Loan F06 Decision-Support Summary
Loan F06 is a flexible equipment financing option ideal for new business owners seeking to fund essential purchases without the need for collateral (for amounts under $75,000).
With a 7-year term and an 11.4% annual interest rate, it offers manageable repayment schedules to align with long-term business growth.
Key features include:
Quick approval within 3 business days.

Late payment fee of 4% on overdue amounts.
Loan F06 is well-suited for businesses in need of upfront equipment financing with predictable, structured repayment.
Consider your cash flow projections and repayment capacity before committing.
Is Loan F06 right for you? If you need equipment financing, want a fast approval process, and prefer a non-collateralized option for amounts under $75,000, Loan F06 could be an excellent fit.

Decision-Support Summary: Bond F08
Credit Quality: Bond F08 has an A rating from a major credit agency, indicating a relatively low credit risk.
Coupon & Payments: It offers a 4.9% annual coupon, paid semi-annually, providing regular income.
Maturity: The bond has a 18-year term, meaning it will mature in 2039 (assuming issuance in 2021).
Call Feature: The bond can be called by the issuer after seven years, potentially limiting gains if interest rates fall.
Transaction Costs: Selling before maturity may result in higher transaction costs, affecting overall returns.
Tax Benefit: Interest is exempt from state income tax in the issuing state, which may enhance after-tax returns for residents.

Consideration: Bond F08 offers a competitive coupon and tax benefits but involves a long time to maturity and potential liquidity constraints. Investors should weigh the call risk and transaction costs against the yield and tax advantages.
Bond F08 Decision-Support Summary
Bond F08 offers a compelling opportunity for investors seeking a stable, long-term return with favorable tax benefits.
With an A rating from a major credit agency, the bond reflects a strong credit profile, providing confidence in its ability to meet payment obligations.
It offers a 4.9% annual coupon, paid semi-annually, delivering consistent income over its 18-year term.
Notably, the bond’s interest is exempt from state income tax in the issuing state, making it especially attractive for investors in higher-tax environments.
This tax-exempt feature enhances the overall yield and can be a valuable tool for long-term savings goals, such as future housing needs.
While the bond can be called after year seven, the investor can still benefit from a steady income stream and the tax advantages over the full 18-year period if held to maturity.
Investors should be mindful of potential transaction costs if selling prior to maturity.
Bond F08 aligns well with a conservative, tax-conscious investment strategy and supports the goal of building a secure financial foundation for future housing needs.
Portfolio F09 Decision-Support Summary
Portfolio F09 is automatically assigned based on a questionnaire placing you into one of eight portfolio bands, ensuring alignment with your risk profile.
The portfolio benefits from automatic rebalancing, maintaining optimal asset allocation without manual intervention.
A 0.60% annual advisory fee applies.
Tax-loss harvesting is available for taxable accounts with balances above $25,000.
If you need personalized guidance, advisor calls are available at $75 per session.
Note that transfers out of the platform may take up to five business days.
Decision-Support Summary: Portfolio F09
Portfolio F09 is a well-suited option for first-time investors seeking a balanced, automated approach to wealth management. Here's what you need to know before making your decision:
Tailored Allocation: Based on your risk profile, Portfolio F09 is selected from eight distinct portfolio bands, ensuring your investments align with your goals and comfort level.
Automatic Rebalancing: The portfolio is automatically rebalanced to maintain its strategic asset allocation, reducing the need for manual oversight.

Advisory Fee: An annual fee of 0.60% covers ongoing portfolio management, including access to professional guidance and tools like tax-loss harvesting (available for taxable accounts with a minimum of $25,000).
Advisor Support: For additional insight, you can schedule calls with a human advisor for $75 per session.
Transfer Timeline: If you need to transfer funds out of the platform, please note it may take up to five business days.
Why Choose Portfolio F09?
It offers a streamlined, cost-effective solution with expert oversight, making it ideal for investors who want a hands-off yet informed approach to long-term growth.
Consider increasing your allocation to benefit from the platform’s automation, tax efficiency, and professional guidance.
Advance F10 Decision-Support Summary
Advance F10 offers rapid funding, with disbursement within 48 hours of approval, making it a timely option for your growing retail operation.
Repayment is collected as a fixed share of daily card receipts, using a factor rate of 1.28 on the funded amount.
This means repayment is based on a percentage of sales and not on a fixed interest rate.
Collections continue daily until the full purchased amount is repaid.
Note that early remittance does not reduce the total amount due, and no property lien is recorded, preserving asset flexibility.
This product may be suitable if consistent daily card sales are expected to support repayment.
Advance F10 Decision-Support Summary
Overview:
Advance F10 offers a fast, flexible cash flow solution designed to support growing retail operations, including new store launches and expansion efforts.
With a fixed factor rate of 1.28 and rapid fund disbursement (within 48 hours), it provides timely access to capital with a repayment structure tied to daily card sales.
Key Features:
Repayment Structure: Repayment is collected as a fixed share of daily card receipts, ensuring that payments align with cash flow.
Factor Rate: A total factor rate of 1.28 applies to the funded amount (e.g., $10,000 funded results in a total repayment of $12,800).
No Early Payoff Benefit: Early remittance does not reduce the total repayment amount.
No Collateral Required: No property lien is recorded, preserving asset flexibility.
Collections Until Paid in Full: Daily collections continue until the total purchased amount is fully repaid.
Fast Funding: Funds are typically disbursed within 48 hours after approval, supporting urgent operational needs.
Considerations for Expansion:
With a second location now open, Advance F10 can provide working capital to support inventory restocking, payroll, or other operational expenses.
The repayment structure is designed to be less disruptive than traditional loans, particularly during periods of fluctuating sales.
Conclusion:
Advance F10 is a viable option for retailers seeking immediate working capital with a predictable, revenue-linked repayment model.
Its speed, simplicity, and lack of collateral make it well-suited for businesses in growth phases.
Decision-Support Summary: Invoice Service F11
Fee Structure: Starts at 2.4% for the first 30 days, increasing afterward.
Credit Check: No personal credit check required for invoices from verified business clients.

Documentation: Additional documentation is required for invoices from new or overseas clients.

Transparency: Online dashboard provides real-time tracking of invoice status, payment dates, and fee accruals.
Use this summary to assess whether Invoice Service F11 aligns with your client mix, cash-flow needs, and risk tolerance.
Invoice Service F11 Decision-Support Summary
Ideal For: Freelancers with repeat clients seeking fast access to working capital without a personal credit check.
Key Benefits:
Fast Advances: Get up to 85% of approved invoice value within 24 hours.
No Personal Credit Check: Required only for invoices from verified business clients.
User-Friendly Dashboard: Track invoice status, expected payment dates, and fee accruals in one place.
Consider the Following:
Fee Structure: The service fee starts at 2.4% for the first 30 days and increases afterward—review the full fee schedule to understand long-term costs.
Client Responsibility: You remain responsible for repayment if a client disputes or refuses payment.
Documentation for New/Overseas Clients: Additional paperwork is required for invoices from new or international clients, which may delay approval.

Education Savings Plan F12 Decision-Support Summary
Contribution Flexibility: Start automatic monthly contributions with as little as $25.
Investment Adjustments: Investment options can be changed only twice per calendar year.
Fees: A 0.35% program management fee is charged in addition to underlying fund expenses.
Tax Benefits: Qualified education withdrawals are exempt from federal tax.
Penalties: Non-qualified withdrawals are subject to income tax and a 10% penalty on earnings.
Portfolio Strategy: Age-based portfolios adjust to a more conservative approach as the beneficiary nears college.
Use this summary to assess whether Plan F12 aligns with your savings goals, flexibility needs, and comfort with fees.
Education Savings Plan F12 Decision-Support Summary
Overview:
Education Savings Plan F12 is a tax-advantaged investment option for families saving for future educational expenses.
With flexible contribution options, tax benefits, and age-based investment strategies, it supports long-term planning for a child’s education.
Key Features:
Tax Advantages:
Qualified withdrawals for education expenses are exempt from federal income tax, making it a powerful tool for growing savings efficiently.
Convenience & Flexibility:
Automatic monthly contributions can begin with as little as $25/month, making it accessible for families at any income level.
Age-based portfolios automatically adjust to a more conservative investment strategy as the beneficiary nears college, reducing risk over time.
Investment Management:
Investment options can be changed up to twice per calendar year.
A 0.35% program management fee applies in addition to the underlying fund expenses—important to consider when evaluating total costs.
Penalties for Non-Qualified Use:
Non-qualified withdrawals are subject to income tax and a 10% penalty on earnings, so funds should be used for eligible education expenses to avoid financial consequences.
Conclusion:
Education Savings Plan F12 offers a structured, tax-efficient way to save for education, with low barriers to entry and adaptive investment strategies.
For families committed to education savings, it can be a smart choice—especially when contributions are made consistently and funds are used for qualified expenses.
Decision-Support Summary: Treasury Account F13
Overview:
Treasury Account F13 is a liquidity-focused investment vehicle designed for balances of $100,000 or more.
It offers next-business-day liquidity for standard redemptions and invests in short-duration government securities.
Key Features:
Liquidity: Next-business-day redemption for standard requests, though redemptions may be delayed during periods of market-wide liquidity stress.
Minimum Balance: Requires a $100,000 minimum opening balance.
Investment Strategy: Balances are invested in short-duration government securities.
Transparency: Monthly statements provide detailed classifications of holdings by maturity, issuer type, and yield.
Risk Consideration: The account is not insured by a bank deposit guarantee scheme.
Considerations for Decision-Making:
Suitable for organizations seeking short-term liquidity with exposure to government securities.
Minimum balance may limit accessibility for smaller balances.
Lack of deposit insurance means principal is subject to market and credit risks, though these are typically low for government securities.
Potential for redemption delays during market stress should be factored into cash flow planning.
This summary is intended to support evaluation of Treasury Account F13 in the context of the charity’s liquidity needs and risk tolerance.
Decision-Support Summary: Treasury Account F13
Overview:
Treasury Account F13 is a liquidity-focused investment solution designed for organizations with significant cash balances seeking to preserve capital while earning competitive returns.
Given your recent corporate donation, this account could help optimize the use of your increased liquidity.
Key Features:
Liquidity: Provides next-business-day redemption for standard requests, supporting ready access to funds.
Minimum Balance: Requires a $100,000 opening balance—well within your new cash position.
Investment Strategy: Balances are invested in short-duration government securities, offering low risk and stable returns.
Transparency: Monthly statements provide detailed breakdowns of holdings by maturity, issuer type, and yield.
Liquidity Risk: Redemptions may be delayed during periods of market-wide stress—important to consider in extreme market conditions.
Considerations:

Purpose: Ideal for short-term cash management and yield enhancement for non-essential reserves.
Conclusion:
Treasury Account F13 offers a balanced approach for your organization to manage increased liquidity—providing competitive returns with next-day access.
It is a suitable option for portions of your donation that do not require immediate use and can tolerate minimal investment risk.
Decision-Support Summary: Annuity Offer F14
Annuity Offer F14 provides a guaranteed fixed monthly payment for life, offering stable income in retirement.
A surviving spouse would continue to receive 60% of the original payment amount.
An optional inflation adjustment is available at purchase, but it reduces the initial monthly payment.
Consider this trade-off based on your long-term inflation expectations.
Be aware that the annuity has no cash surrender value after the free-look period, meaning it cannot be cashed out later for its original value.
Also, if you plan to make beneficiary changes, the insurer may apply a 3% administrative adjustment.
Evaluate your financial needs, liquidity requirements, and beneficiary plans before committing.
Decision-Support Summary: Annuity Offer F14
Overview:
Annuity Offer F14 provides a guaranteed fixed monthly payment for life, offering retirees a predictable and stable income stream—ideal for managing long-term financial needs.
Key Features:
Spousal Continuation: Payments continue to a surviving spouse at 60% of the original amount, ensuring ongoing financial support.
Inflation Adjustment Option: Available at purchase, this feature helps maintain purchasing power over time. Note: Electing this option will reduce the initial monthly payment.
No Cash Surrender Value: After the free-look period, the annuity does not have a cash surrender value—meaning funds cannot be withdrawn for cash value.
Administrative Adjustment: A 3% charge may apply for certain beneficiary changes; review carefully before requesting modifications.
Considerations for Retirees Abroad:
With a portion of the year spent abroad, the predictability and reliability of fixed lifetime payments can provide peace of mind.
The spousal continuation and optional inflation adjustment can help tailor the annuity to your long-term needs.
Conclusion:

Annuity Offer F14 is a strong option for retirees seeking lifetime income security, particularly if you value stability, spousal protection, and the ability to hedge against inflation through the optional rider.
We recommend reviewing your long-term income needs and beneficiary plans to determine the optimal amount to commit.
Credit Facility F15 Decision-Support Summary
Overview:
Credit Facility F15 offers a $2 million financing option for the startup, enabling access to capital without immediate equity dilution.
Key Features:
Capital Access: Funds can be drawn in multiple tranches tied to hiring milestones.
Equity Component: The lender receives warrants for 0.75% of fully diluted equity.
Payment Structure: Interest-only payments for the first 12 months, easing short-term cash flow pressure.
Covenants: A monthly minimum cash covenant must be maintained.
Change-of-Control Clause: Triggers immediate repayment of all outstanding principal.
Considerations:
The facility allows flexibility in capital use while preserving equity.
The warrant component introduces a future dilution risk.
The minimum cash covenant requires consistent financial discipline.
Immediate repayment upon a change of control could create liquidity risk in acquisition scenarios.
Conclusion:
Credit Facility F15 offers a flexible, milestone-based capital solution with manageable near-term obligations.
The decision to commit should weigh the value of preserving equity against the covenant and dilution risks.
Credit Facility F15 Decision-Support Summary
Overview:
Credit Facility F15 offers a $2 million flexible financing option for pre-seed software startups, enabling capital access without immediate equity dilution.
The facility is structured to support growth through hiring milestones and provides a 12-month interest-only period to ease early-stage cash flow pressures.
Key Benefits:
Capital Access: Up to $2M available in multiple tranches tied to hiring milestones.
Equity Efficiency: Warrants only (0.75% of fully diluted equity) instead of upfront equity exchange.
Operational Flexibility: Interest-only payments for the first 12 months.
Scalability: Draws aligned with growth, supporting team expansion and operational needs.
Considerations:
Cash Covenant: Monthly minimum cash balance must be maintained.
Change-of-Control Trigger: Full repayment required if the company undergoes a merger, acquisition, or similar event.
Strategic Use Case:
Ideal for pre-seed startups seeking growth capital without immediate equity trade-offs, especially those with a clear hiring roadmap and short-term runway needs.
The warrant structure preserves equity while providing flexibility for future financing rounds.
Recommendation:
Evaluate F15 as a strategic tool to fund near-term growth, particularly if the company plans to raise additional capital or scale rapidly within 12 months.

Solar Lease F16 Decision-Support Summary

Key Benefits:
Lower Initial Cost: Monthly payments are lower than your current average electricity bill in Year 1.

No Upfront Investment: No need to pay for installation or maintenance—fully managed by the provider.

Solar Lease F16 is a low-risk, hassle-free way to enjoy solar energy with guaranteed performance and lower initial costs.
It’s ideal for homeowners seeking predictable savings and long-term energy value, especially in a neighborhood with recent home turnover.

Transparent Costs: The app clearly shows the exchange rate and delivery fee before you confirm the transfer.

Decision-Support Summary for Mortgage Offer F18
Mortgage Offer F18 provides a refinance opportunity with a reduced fixed interest rate of 0.9 percentage points and eliminates the need for mortgage insurance.
Rolling closing costs into the loan increases the principal by $7,800 and restarts the repayment term at 30 years.
The advertised rate requires purchasing 1.5 discount points at closing.
This option may be beneficial if the long-term savings from the lower rate and removal of insurance outweigh the increased principal and extended loan term.
Mortgage Offer F18 Decision-Support Summary
Mortgage Offer F18 presents a strategic opportunity to improve your financial position, especially with one partner transitioning to contract work. Here's how it benefits you:
Lower Interest Rate: The new fixed rate is 0.9 percentage points lower than your current loan, reducing long-term interest costs.
Remove Mortgage Insurance: The refinance eliminates the need for mortgage insurance, saving you money each month.
Roll in Closing Costs: You can include $7,800 in closing costs into the new loan principal, preserving cash flow at closing.
Restart Loan Term: While the new loan resets the 30-year term, the lower rate and removed insurance may result in a net monthly savings.
Consideration: Purchasing 1.5 discount points is required to secure the advertised rate. Evaluate whether this upfront cost aligns with your financial goals and how long you plan to stay in the home.
Mortgage Offer F18 offers a competitive balance of cost savings, flexibility, and long-term value—making it a strong option for your current financial transition.
Payment Reserve Policy F19 – Decision-Support Summary
Reserve Activation: 15% of gross sales are withheld while active.
Pause Conditions: Releases paused if a high-risk complaint is received.
Reserve Reduction: Percentage decreases automatically after 3 months with no disputes.
Protection: Shields against chargeback invoices during reserve period.
Funds Release: Earnings from completed orders released weekly on schedule.

Use this summary to assess whether the reserve terms align with your financial planning and risk tolerance for imported inventory financing.
Decision-Support Summary: Payment Reserve Policy F19
Overview:
Payment Reserve Policy F19 withholds 15% of gross sales to protect sellers from chargebacks and high-risk complaints.
This reserve is held for up to three months or until disputes are resolved, with funds released on a weekly schedule for completed orders.
Key Considerations for Sellers:
Protection from Chargebacks: The reserve shields you from unexpected chargeback invoices during the reserve period.
Predictable Cash Flow: While 15% is withheld, funds from completed orders are released weekly, helping maintain operational liquidity.
Reserve Reduction: The reserve percentage decreases automatically after three months with no disputes, reducing the hold on future sales.
Pause for High-Risk Complaints: If a high-risk complaint arises, reserve releases may be paused temporarily until resolution.
No Interest on Reserved Funds: You will not earn interest on funds held in reserve.
Decision Point:
If you are managing increased inventory and sales during the holiday season, this policy offers a balance of risk mitigation and structured cash flow.
